'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
